environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Set the PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE credential for the ThreatLocker MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: THREATLOCKER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Portal API key (ThreatLocker portal: Settings > API Keys), sent as the Authorization header on every call.

environmentVariables.name: THREATLOCKER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the ThreatLocker API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: THREATLOCKER_ORG_ID
environmentVariables.description: Tenant GUID sent as ManagedOrganizationId (the --org flag overrides it). Most Portal API data calls answer 401/403 without it, so set it unless you pass --org on every call.

environmentVariables.name: THREATLOCKER_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on ThreatLocker requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.
